reference_source.attribution: VP62.cpp and VP62.h state that they come from ffdshow. Exact historical origin/libvp62 relationship not established.

provenance_limits: Public MFNode/ffdshow VP62 is semantic reference, not established original EA/On2 source.
Function and member names come from donor PDB/MAP; target table references, behavior and checked field accesses support the correspondences.
Partial PB views model only accessed target offsets, not the complete donor layout.
Code/Libraries/Source/VP6/decodembs.cpp groups the recovered library unit using the donor basename; no original BFME2 on-disk VP6 source path was found.

frame_decoder.name: _VP6_DecodeFrameMbs
frame_decoder.identity_basis: Both independently matched 64-byte default scan tables; calls into table-anchored mode/entropy updates; matching donor frame-type and Huffman branches, 64-entry merged scan, row/column traversal, and existing macroblock decoder.
frame_decoder.codegen_findings: Separate memcpy calls in the interlaced/noninterlaced branches reproduce shared setup scheduling; separate zero assignments preserve retail store order.

callee_pins.name: _VP6_ConfigureEntropyDecoder
callee_pins.entry_kind: full cdecl function, not a thunk
callee_pins.identity_basis: Target independently references equal ScanBandUpdateProbs and VP6_AcUpdateProbs; 2x11 DC, 1..63 scan, 2x14 zero-run and 3x2x6x11 AC update logic agrees with donor and semantic reference. Four called helpers already have matched ledger bodies.

callee_pins.name: _VP6_ConfigureMvEntropyDecoder
callee_pins.entry_kind: full cdecl function, not a thunk
callee_pins.identity_basis: Complete34-byte motion update table is independently equal in target, named donor and public reference; two sign/short updates then 2x7 and 2x8 probability loops write +704,+706,+708,+71C. Calls existing matched bool decoder1C4F00 and bitread1BCF40. Donor cdecl PB pointer plus unsigned char agrees with frame caller; second argument unused.

callee_pins.name: _ConvertBoolTrees
callee_pins.entry_kind: full cdecl function, not a thunk
callee_pins.identity_basis: Target converts two DC, two zero-run and 3x2x6 AC probability trees into Huffman trees, lookup tables, codes and lengths. Target field offsets match donor DcHuff/ZeroHuff/AcHuff fields individually. The 12-token and 9-token loops call existing matched expansion1BBAF0/1BBC40, lookup1C6BA0 and tree-code walker1C6C20. Same donor semantic call sequence; name is not inferred from call order alone.

motion_update_table.relation: Source arrays interleaved by component as 2 sign/short + 7 short + 8 long entries; complete 34-byte equality to donor and target.
